objective_breakdown: Three cell-level contract metrics + standard safety exam: ED>=446.18 Wh/kg (chemistry+architecture lever), 5C retention>=0.90 (rate lever, opposite to ED lever: thick electrodes hurt rate), mass<=40 g (stack mass cap => E<=~17.8 Wh, moderate cell). Multi-objective trade-off: ED vs 5C (thickness), ED vs T_max (areal loading/heat). Safety: 4C charge @45C lumped+plating, T_max<=333.15 K, no plating.
candidate_strategy: R0: Chen2020 baseline 1C/5C DFN + calc-energy (ED, mass, 5C retention) + opening ceiling assessment. R1: 3 architecture variants on Chen2020 - A High-ED (thick electrodes, thin collectors/sep), B Rate-ED balanced (moderate thickness + electrolyte transport boost sigma/t+), C Thin-fast (probe rate ceiling). R2: refine winner. R3: 4C charge safety on best. Escalation path if ED ceiling < 446: LNMO 4.7V system switch -> electrolyte formulation -> electrode composition (run-comp).
budget_allocation: flash case: R0 ~3 sims; R1 ~10 sims; R2 ~6 sims; R3 ~2 sims; total ~20 pybamm runs; no true DFT (real_compute=false, honest endorse skip).
risk_and_fallback: Risk1 ED unreachable with NMC811/graphite given 5C constraint -> escalate Stage 2 (LNMO switch/electrolyte/composition). Risk2 5C<90% on thick electrodes -> thin+high-sigma/t+ + small particles, document Pareto. Risk3 T_max>333.15 K -> thermal lever locked h=10; if fails question boundary and report honestly. Three-strike questioning layers: (1) system physical reachability, (2) system-switch boundary, (3) metric reachability -> negative result with 'reachable if X relaxed' note.

detail: Base determination: Chen2020 (task text names no electrode system -> anchor table default, recorded). System candidate Chen2020 passed to Stage 3 baseline characterization; props source=baseline (literature parameter set). Opening ceiling assessment: NMC811/graphite stack ED ceiling with thin inactives (8/6 um collectors, 9-12 um separator, low porosity) ~450-500 Wh/kg contract-caliber; 5C retention is the binding constraint (baseline 8.7%: solid-diffusion limited, D_s,pos=4e-15 m2/s, r_pos=5.22 um, tau~6800 s). Lever set for rate: positive particle radius (r^2/D scaling, allowed lever), electrolyte transport sigma/D/t+ (formulation), electrode thickness (ED-rate Pareto). No molecular funnel needed this round (system/architecture candidates only).

Opening ceiling assessment: thin collectors (Al 8 um/Cu 6 um, literature high-ED cell practice) cut inactive mass 0.1506->0.0779 kg/m2 => ED(f)=17.41f/(0.2699f+0.0779) reaches 446 at f>=0.68; all variants mass < 40 g. 5C fix = physical levers only: particle radius (r^2/D scaling; nano NMC ~1.5 um literature high-power practice; neg 2 um fine graphite), electrolyte transport formulation (sigma 1.3 S/m literature high-conductivity LiPF6 EC/EMC; D 4e-10 m2/s literature range; t+ 0.45 ESTIMATE high-transference formulation - marked estimate, not simulation output). Nominal cell capacity set self-consistent (5.0/4.0/3.4 Ah = 5 Ah x f) so '5C' protocol is a true 5C rate (mislabeled-current trap avoided; will verify |actual-nominal|<=3%). N/P ratio preserved (1.127). Funnel: no molecular candidates (architecture+formulation only; t+ and D are formulation candidates with literature/estimate source, no funnel needed per protocol table).

recommendation: Final design: V4 Thermal-tuned (Chen2020 NMC811/graphite + fast package). Spec: 3.45 Ah, 3.9 V midpoint, 13.4 Wh, 473.0 Wh/kg contract-caliber, 26.8 g stack mass, 5C retention 99.0% (DFN), 4C-charge@45C T_max 331.98 K (<=333.15), no lithium plating (anode potential min +0.025 V), 5C-discharge T_max 321.2 K. Key levers: nano particles (pos 1.0 um / neg 1.5 um), high-transport electrolyte (sigma 1.4 S/m, D 4.5e-10 m2/s, t+ 0.5 estimate), thin collectors (Al 8 um / Cu 6 um), thin electrodes (51.4/57.9 um), separator porosity 0.55, flatter-pouch cooling area 0.0075 m2. Comparison: baseline Chen2020 ED 400.8/retention 8.7%/mass 43.5 g -> V4 all-contract pass. Attribution: transport+particles ~2.6 K, cooling area ~2.8 K on 4C T_max (V5 control 334.7 K). Informational: aging 100 cyc SEI 467 nm (climb-then-saturate artifact labeled), overcharge T_max 300.6 K no thermal runaway.
limitations: Cell mass excludes electrolyte/casing (contract formula, electrolyte density not in parameter set); 5C/1C retention uses self-consistent nameplate capacity (nominal=actual within 1.5%); t+ 0.5 is a domain estimate (high-transference electrolyte, not simulation-derived); T_max margin only 1.2 K at 4C/45C with h=10; no physical-prototype validation; no nail/crush/drop verification (beyond simulation boundary).
